title: As a toddler, his sister says, he'd declare "counting days" and try to count as high as he could.
caption:
As a toddler, his sister says, he'd declare "counting days" and try to count as high as he could.

In 2006, his father died after a long illness. He says within four years, it was about 95% curable.

His death helped push him from physics to biology, then AI: Baidu, Google, then OpenAI, where he led GPT-3.

In 2022, he held back Claude for safety testing. Three months later, ChatGPT launched.

That toddler is Dario Amodei. Forbes puts his net worth at $15.5 billion.

Would you have held it back?
